lines.zh: 四条腿走起来比两条稳。
lines.en: Four legs carry me steadier than two.

lines.zh: 我是它长出的一副大骨架。
lines.en: I'm the big frame it grew.
The snow can't hold my weight.
I move forward for no particular reason.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的门还宽。
lines.en: My shadow is wider than your door.
Walk, stop, sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 脚印踩得很深，你能追上。
lines.en: The prints sink deep; you can follow.

lines.zh: 我这身皮不是长出来的。
lines.en: This hide wasn't grown on me.

lines.zh: 绕过那棵树，它就挡不住我。
lines.en: Around the tree; it can't stop me.
I'm looking for a hole that fits me.
My joints click as I walk.
Come nearer and you'll see clearly.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我在数同伴。
lines.en: Standing here, I count my kin.
Slow breathing. I have no lungs.
My shoulders are thicker than stumps.
The hide tightens across my back.
I don't roar; a roar gives me away.
Snow lands on my back and doesn't melt.
The scent of this place is new.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，又轻轻放下。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg, then set it down.
I'm waiting for one that strays.
Quiet enough to hear my own bones.
Could I wear that hide of yours?

lines.zh: 我记得你刚才数过自己人。
lines.en: I saw you count your own just now.
Don't go far. I know the way.
You're shaking. I don't quite understand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不是这副身体的。
lines.en: These eyes aren't this body's.
Stand still; let me see your shape.
I'm big, so I'm in no hurry.
Run if you want. I'll wait.
The hide is cut; it's hollow inside.

lines.zh: 这一下不够让我换身体。
lines.en: Not enough to make me change bodies.
I snarled, but not from pain.
The wound is closing slowly.
I backed two steps to make room.

lines.zh: 骨头断了一根，我不在意。
lines.en: A bone broke. I don't care.
You hit the hide.
My weight keeps me upright.
Try again. I haven't changed shape.
That much meat barely fills a tooth gap.
You hold it up, so I come.
The smell is real; I can't taste it.

lines.zh: 给我，我就能记住你的手。
lines.en: Give it to me and I'll know your hands.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我喜欢这个姿势。
lines.en: Not hungry, but I like this posture.
Drop it and I'll lower my head.
Have you fed anything else already?
There's a blade under the meat, right?
Closer. A little closer.
I can smell your sweat.
Bump me and you'll bounce off.

lines.zh: 我这身骨架，不打算让路。
lines.en: This frame doesn't intend to move.
You press against me like a wall.
Don't push; the hide sticks.
Your shoulder made a sound.

lines.zh: 我低下头，你正好在下面。
lines.en: I lower my head; you're right under it.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，容不下两具身体。
lines.en: Too narrow here for two bodies.
One step back and I'll let you pass.
A touch is enough. No more.

lines.zh: 我们两具身体挤在一起。
lines.en: Two of these frames press together.
This isn't mating. It's overlapping.

lines.zh: 大个子和大个子，动静很大。
lines.en: Two big ones make a big noise.

lines.zh: 留下的东西会自己站起来。
lines.en: What's left will stand up on its own.
Don't watch me do this.
It's a little bigger than me.
Together, apart, and now there's one more.
There's no ceremony between us.
Our fur has tangled together.
The next one will be bigger.
I pick up a log in my teeth.
This stone crumbles in one squeeze.
I can lift what's yours.
Pick it up, and it stays picked up.
I use my mouth; the claws are clumsy.
The iron clinks in my grip.
I stuff it under a tree.
I'll keep this grass until tomorrow.
What's left on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 捡东西这件事，我很在行。
lines.en: I'm good at picking things up.
You carry the heat of something alive.
You'll do. The others are too far.
I caught your scent past the trees.

lines.zh: 别动，我正在认你的形状。
lines.en: Hold still; I'm learning your shape.

lines.zh: 大个子追起来不快，可追得久。
lines.en: A big one isn't fast, but it lasts.
Target set. The frame tightens.

lines.zh: 退路只有一条，被我堵着。
lines.en: One way out, and I'm in it.

lines.zh: 你刚插的火把出卖了你。
lines.en: The torch you just placed gave you away.

lines.zh: 这片林子只够藏一个人。
lines.en: This grove only hides one.

lines.zh: 我踏碎一根树枝，你知道我来了。
lines.en: I snap a branch so you know I'm coming.

lines.zh: 你也许会赢，但不会轻松。
lines.en: You might win, but not easily.
The wind pushes you toward me.
Several living things in a row.
I want you to stay here.

lines.zh: 你和我之间，只隔两棵树。
lines.en: Two trees between us.
Always walking, always watching.
Hide in a cave; I'll wait at the mouth.
I don't chase fast. I chase to the end.
The scent on this path hasn't faded.

lines.zh: 你把门关上了，我从后墙来。
lines.en: You shut the door; I come through the back.
I push down the low trees.

lines.zh: 我知道你在哪块石头后面。
lines.en: I know which rock you're behind.
Your silence only confirms it.
The prints in the snow are fresh.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，你听得见。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy. You can hear it.
Detours won't help. I follow.

lines.zh: 你藏起来的样子太明显。
lines.en: You're obvious when you hide.

lines.zh: 太阳落山前，我找得到你。
lines.en: Before sunset, I'll find you.
One more block and it's a dead end.
The harder you breathe, the easier.
I'm one arrow-shot away now.
Stop looking for me. I don't hide.
This blow could break a doorframe.

lines.zh: 我的前爪比你的护甲厚。
lines.en: My forepaw is thicker than your armor.
Press down and you can't move.

lines.zh: 你挡的是这个，我打的是那边。
lines.en: You blocked here; I struck there.

lines.zh: 骨头撞在一起，声音很闷。
lines.en: Bone hits bone with a dull sound.
That's enough to send you to the wall.
My claws pass, and the bark splits too.
No roar. Just the hit.

lines.zh: 你在我一次挥击的范围里。
lines.en: You're inside one swing of me.
Blood is warm. I smell it.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头，就是为了这个。
lines.en: This skeleton is built for this.
Your shield dented.
I press you into the snow.
After the blow, this body still stands.
Shoulder, back, leg. I'll pick one.
Don't look up. I'm not up there.
That was loud. I like it.
Enough? Not yet.
I rise out of a heap of hide.

lines.zh: 这里有一具空的大身体。
lines.en: Here's a large empty body.

lines.zh: 不是刷的，是被带过来的。
lines.en: Not spawned. Brought.
When I landed, the snow packed tight.
The tree shadow fits me nicely.

lines.zh: 这个身体很大，站起来费劲。
lines.en: This body is large; standing costs effort.
First, I learn the scents around.

lines.zh: 同化的结果是这个样子。
lines.en: This is what assimilation produces.
I've walked out of the woods.
It's quiet here. I don't mind.
The snow left a pit where I stood.

lines.zh: 你听见树倒的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that tree fall?

lines.zh: 火顺着毛爬上来，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Fire climbs my fur and won't shake off.

lines.zh: 这重量砸下去，骨头断了。
lines.en: With this weight, the landing broke bone.

lines.zh: 水进了我的壳，沉得很快。
lines.en: Water fills my frame. I sink fast.

lines.zh: 炸开的皮翻过来，露出里面。
lines.en: The blast turns my hide out, showing the inside.
An arrow in my shoulder, like a splinter.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我想换形状。
lines.en: Potion light makes me want to change shape.
I stand fine without eating.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我这具身体焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; this body is scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面的声音。
lines.en: In the void there's no sound of ground.
